title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN TO PAY TO F. W. DARBY, SHERIFF OF PANGASINAN, THE SUM OF SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR DOLLARS AND FORTY-NINE CENTS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, FOR SERVICES RENDERED BY HIM IN MAY, JUNE, AND JULY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN TO PAY TO F. W. DARBY, SHERIFF OF PANGASINAN, THE SUM OF SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR DOLLARS AND FORTY-NINE CENTS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, FOR SERVICES RENDERED BY HIM IN MAY, JUNE, AND JULY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Hội đồng Tỉnh Pangasinan chi trả cho F. W. Darby, Cảnh sát trưởng tỉnh Pangasinan, số tiền 634 đô la Mỹ và 49 xu để đền bù cho các dịch vụ ông thực hiện vào tháng Năm, tháng Sáu và tháng Bảy năm 1902
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้สภาจังหวัดปังกาซินันจ่ายเงินจำนวน634ดอลลาร์สหรัฐและ49เซนต์ให้แก่เอฟดับเบิลยูดาร์บี้นายอำเภอจังหวัดปังกาซินันเพื่อตอบแทนบริการที่เขาให้ไว้ในเดือนพฤษภาคมมิถุนายนและกรกฎาคมพ.ศ.2445
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan Dewan Provinsi Pangasinan membayar kepada F. W. Darby, Sheriff Pangasinan, jumlah 634 dolar Amerika Serikat dan 49 sen sebagai imbalan atas jasa yang diberikannya pada bulan Mei, Juni, dan Juli tahun 1902

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Pangasinan is hereby authorized and directed to order the
payment to F. W. Darby, sheriff of Pangasinan, of the sum of six hundred and thirty-four dollars and forty-
nine cents. United States currency, or Such part thereof as may be necessary, for services rendered by him m
May, June, and July, nineteen hundred and two, in serving processes of the court, executing judgments, and
executing prisoners, anything in previous laws to the contrary notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 16, 1902.
